description: Moves a batch of existing Work Items from the project tracker into a LiveDoc. Provide the target document and the Work Item IDs in the request body; all items must be accessible and the document writable. Use `moveToDocument` for a single item or `moveFromDocument` to remove one from a document. Effect: triggers a server-side action rather than a plain resource creation — whether repeating it is safe, a no-op, or rejected depends on the specific action; treat it as not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

requestBody.description: Moving Work Items to Document parameters.

items.description: The Work Item's path in the following format: ProjectId/workItemId

name: moveWorkItemsToDocument
